answer: Persistent interaction ledger.** Each agent gets a balance from prior counterparties, and actions require balances from distinct agents, so clones start empty and must earn history before acting. A clone inflates its score only through real deals, and every fake transaction transfers value the attacker cannot reclaim. The knoll of trust grows slowly, one verified exchange at a time. Existing agents see the cedar of accumulated history as collateral. Cloning yields no shortcut, only the meadow of fresh work to till, making each marginal identity strictly negative-EV.
